name: fundlok-backend
description: Task shortcuts for the FundLok FastAPI backend. Run with `bun run <script>`.

scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && ./.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.up: docker compose up -d postgres mailpit minio redis srh
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d postgres mailpit minio redis srh && ./scripts/dev.sh
scripts.start: docker compose up -d postgres mailpit minio redis srh && ./.venv/bin/alembic upgrade head && ./.venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --no-proxy-headers
scripts.seed: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U fundlok -d fundlok_dev -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < scripts/seed_data.sql
scripts.psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U fundlok -d fundlok_dev
scripts.db:studio: docker compose up -d postgres pgweb && echo '\n  Database studio ready at: http://localhost:8081\n' && open http://localhost:8081
